# Mote rules

<!-- Generated by `mote rules --all --format markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

5 rules, 5 enabled by default. Severity: **HIGH** — almost certainly a bug or a serious reliability hazard; **MEDIUM** — a likely problem or a significant maintainability cost; **LOW** — minor or stylistic. The default quality gate fails a pull request on new HIGH findings only. Change severities, parameters and enablement in `.mote.yaml` (`mote config explain <file>` shows the effective settings).
